g.text: Color scales are country-specific; bubble size shows the absolute change in unemployment.
Sources: BLS archived annual averages; Japan LFS; Census Vintage 2022; Basic Resident Registration.
US: civilian noninstitutional 16+, July-to-July migration. Japan: LFS 15+, calendar-year migration, all nationalities.
Population dates: US July 1 / Japan October 1. All 98 regions are visible, including Akita. Descriptive associations.
